title: SPS-PAGE Protein Electrophoresis
author: Konstantinos Ragios
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.775hrq6

Put on the shaker for one hour.

steps.title: Prepare Protein Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the protein samples by mixing buffer, water, and protein in a tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 10μl of 2x Laemmli Buffer, 5μl Nuclease free water, and 5μl of protein sample.
Adjust water:protein ratio based on concentration: for high concentration use 7μl water and 3μl protein; for low concentration use 3μl water and 7μl protein.

steps.title: Mix and Denature Samples
steps.instruction: Ensure samples are homogeneous and denatured via heat.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by pipetting up and down, vortexing, or flicking the tube.
Centrifuge for a few seconds to collect sample at the bottom.
Incubate at 100°C for 15 minutes in a dry heating element (or Thermal Cycler with Heated Cover Temperature set to 105°C to avoid condensation).
Store samples at 4°C until electrophoresis begins.

steps.title: Prepare Casting Equipment
steps.instruction: Clean and assemble the gel casting apparatus.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the tank, the buffer dam (if running an odd number of gels), and the casting stand.
Open the casting gel, remove the comb and the bottom plastic cover, and rinse well.
Insert gel(s) into casting stand(s), including a buffer dam if running one or three gels.
Verify seal by adding water inside the casting stand between the two gels; if no leakage occurs, discard the water.

steps.title: Prepare Negative Control
steps.instruction: Create a negative control sample by mixing 10μl of 2x Laemmli Buffer with 10μl Nuclease free water.

steps.title: Set Up Electrophoresis Tank
steps.instruction: Position the casting stand and fill with buffer.

substeps.instruction: Place the casting stand in the tank.
Fill the inner compartment with 1x TGS Buffer.
Fill the tank to the appropriate mark: '2 Gels' mark for 1-2 gels, or '4 Gels' mark for 3-4 gels.

steps.title: Load Samples and Ladder
steps.instruction: Carefully load the protein samples and ladder into the gel wells using long tips (or 20μl tips).

substeps.instruction: Load 3μl of ladder into one well.
Load 10μl of protein samples and negative control per well.
Verify the tip is inside the well by moving it back and forth (movement should be constricted by glass frames).
Pipette slowly to prevent sample from propelling outside the well.
Close the lid and connect electrodes to the power supply (red to red, black to black).
Set power supply to 120V for 5 minutes; verify bubbles are forming (if not, check cables and add buffer to tank and between gels).
Set power supply to 200V and run for 25 minutes.
Optionally run for a few more minutes at 200V until the blue band is close to the bottom for better separation, ensuring it does not surpass the end.

steps.title: Recover Buffer and Gel
steps.instruction: Disassemble the tank and remove the gel from the frames.

substeps.instruction: Remove the casting stand from the tank and pour the buffer from the stand and tank into a bottle for reuse.
Using clean gloves, carefully open the glass frames using a specialized tool or metal object.
Leave the gel attached to one glass frame for easy transfer.
Clean the gel.

steps.title: Wash Gel
steps.instruction: Release the gel from the frame and wash it in distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Pour distilled water into a bowl (avoid overfilling as it will be placed on a shaker) and place the gel inside.
Flip the frame in the water and shake gently to release the gel from the frame.
Remove water, add fresh distilled water, and shake for 5 minutes, pressing the gel to the bottom with fingers.
Repeat the second wash step (fresh water and 5-minute shake) one more time.

steps.title: Stain the Gel
steps.instruction: Apply Coomassie stain to visualize proteins.

substeps.instruction: Remove water from the bowl and add approximately 50ml of Bio-Safe Coomassie Stain (add more if needed to completely cover the gel).
Remove the Coomassie stain and rinse the gel thoroughly.

steps.title: Destain the Gel
steps.instruction: Remove excess stain using distilled water.

substeps.instruction: Place the gel in a bowl with distilled water on a shaker and let it sit overnight (12-16 hours).
Optionally add precision wipes to the bowl to absorb color, ensuring they are not placed directly on top of the gel.
Optionally renew the water and change wipes after several hours, avoiding overexposure to prevent bands from fading.

steps.title: Image the Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare and capture the final image.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the gel from the bowl and place it in a transparent colorless plastic file folder.
Capture the image using a conventional scanner or the white light mode on a UV transilluminator.
